description: Opt-in container image and APT package update policy for Tuxcrate image repositories

customManagers.description: Update digest-pinned baseImage references in meta.yaml release tracks
Update APT package versions from structured upstream metadata in meta.yaml
matchStrings: tracks[upstream.datasource = 'deb' and $type(upstream.version) = 'string'].{ 'datasource': upstream.datasource, 'depName': upstream.depName, 'registryUrl': upstream.registryUrl, 'currentValue': upstream.version }

packageRules.description: Only propose supported stable APT package versions; PR builds verify both architectures
prBodyNotes: APT discovery checks amd64 only. Require successful uncached linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 PR builds before merging. If arm64 publication is delayed, rerun the failed build after the package becomes available.

packageRules.description: Keep the shared container workflow on its coordinated tooling ref
Pin container images to immutable digests and track upstream changes
